label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.44… supports If c, distinct from x, causes x's esse…
note: Q.44 a.1 ad 2 says an agent cause is required because the effect would not be if the cause were not. The premise applies this to causes of esse (CausesIn c x esse) rather than agent causes, and states it as a universal dependence premise; both are the analyst's.
